name: Nadi International Airport

permits.v: an operator not based in Fiji needs a Foreign Air Operator Certificate of Competency from CAAF for air transport services to, from or within Fiji, except for no more than two take-offs or two landings in Fiji in any 28 consecutive days, or medical emergencies
permits.quote: no person not domiciled in Fiji shall conduct an air transport service to, from or within Fiji ... Foreign Air Operator Certificate of Competency granted by CAAF

notes: The Fiji AIP is not published online; CAAF AIC 03/22 (19 May 2022) says copies are obtained from the Aeronautical Information Service (AISO@fijiairports.com.fj). The airportsfiji.com AIS page gave no AIP link and airportsfiji.com/aboutus.php failed to open. Fiji Airports' Nadi page and the Civil Aviation Master Plan 2026-2031 (Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation) give no runway dimensions or curfew. Only the 24/7 operating statement on Fiji Airports' FAQ page is recorded; it is an operator page, not the AIP. Operator: Airports Fiji Limited (airportsfiji.com, 'manages and operates'). 1 Nov 2026: added a permits rule from the CAAF 'Foreign Air Operator Certification Requirements' page (modified 24 Mar 2025); the page gives no notice period and does not say how charters are classed. CAAF AIC 04/11 (28 Jul 2011) covers only Fiji-based operators of foreign aircraft. No official runway, customs or curfew source found online; the Fiji AIP still has to be ordered from the AIS.
